actionStatus.title: Action Status
actionStatus.description: SUMMARIZED, VALIDATION_ERROR, NOT_FOUND, AUTH_ERROR, BACKEND_ERROR, CALLOUT_FAILED, MALFORMED_RESPONSE, UNEXPECTED_ERROR, or NOT_SUMMARIZED.

safeMessage.title: Safe Message
safeMessage.description: Safe status message for planner reasoning. Do not display when executiveBrief is present.

executiveBrief.title: Revenue Account Health Brief
executiveBrief.description: Display this field as the user-facing answer. It contains the LLM-led Revenue Operations Intelligence decision, risk and opportunity levels, rationale, signals reviewed, and next-best-action plan.

accountHealthScore.title: Account Health Score
accountHealthScore.description: LLM-derived account health score from 0 to 100, where 100 is healthiest. Planner reasoning only.

accountHealthBand.title: Account Health Band
accountHealthBand.description: LLM-derived account health band: excellent, healthy, watch, at_risk, critical, or unknown. Planner reasoning only.

churnRiskScore.title: Churn Risk Score
churnRiskScore.description: LLM-derived churn risk score from 0 to 100, where 100 is highest churn risk. Planner reasoning only.

churnRiskLevel.title: Churn Risk Level
churnRiskLevel.description: LLM-derived churn risk level: low, medium, high, critical, or unknown. Planner reasoning only.

expansionScore.title: Expansion Score
expansionScore.description: LLM-derived expansion potential score from 0 to 100, where 100 is strongest expansion potential. Planner reasoning only.

expansionLevel.title: Expansion Level
expansionLevel.description: LLM-derived expansion level: low, medium, high, or unknown. Planner reasoning only.

deliveryRiskLevel.title: Delivery Risk Level
deliveryRiskLevel.description: LLM-derived services delivery risk level. Planner reasoning only.

financialRiskLevel.title: Financial Risk Level
financialRiskLevel.description: LLM-derived financial risk level. Planner reasoning only.

supportRiskLevel.title: Support Risk Level
supportRiskLevel.description: LLM-derived support burden risk level. Planner reasoning only.

executiveEngagementLevel.title: Executive Engagement Level
executiveEngagementLevel.description: LLM-derived executive engagement level: strong, steady, weak, or unknown. Planner reasoning only.

primaryDecision.title: Primary Decision
primaryDecision.description: Primary LLM decision for revenue operators. Planner reasoning only when executiveBrief is present.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Short safe Revenue Operations Intelligence summary. Planner reasoning only when executiveBrief is present.

decisionRationale.title: Decision Rationale
decisionRationale.description: Concise rationale for the LLM-led decision. Planner reasoning only when executiveBrief is present.

revenueImpact.title: Revenue Impact
revenueImpact.description: LLM-described revenue impact. Planner reasoning only when executiveBrief is present.

operationalBlockers.title: Operational Blockers
operationalBlockers.description: Semicolon-separated operational blockers. Planner reasoning only when executiveBrief is present.

recommendedActions.title: Recommended Actions
recommendedActions.description: Semicolon-separated next-best actions. Planner reasoning only when executiveBrief is present.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: LLM confidence: low, medium, or high. Planner reasoning only.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Internal model provider used for operational diagnostics.

model.title: Model
model.description: Internal model used for operational diagnostics.

fallbackUsed.title: Fallback Used
fallbackUsed.description: True when a fallback provider was used.

httpStatusCode.title: HTTP Status Code
httpStatusCode.description: HTTP status code returned by the internal account-health service.

requestId.title: Request Id
requestId.description: Safe correlation id sent to backend telemetry.

summarizedAt.title: Summarized At
summarizedAt.description: Timestamp when Apex summarized revenue account health.
